newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Spartech EPS view raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Spartech EPS view raised.

text.p: Mesirow Financial said Thursday it raised its 1997 and 1998 earnings per share estimates for Spartech Corp, citing growth in all business units because of recent acquisitions and operating cost-control measures.
Mesirow said it raised its fiscal 1997 earnings estimate to $1.00 a share from $0.88 and its fiscal 1998 estimate to $1.01 from $0.89.
Mesirow said it is maintaining its focus buy rating on the stock, and has set a $14.00 to $15.00 a share price target.
Spartech's fiscal second quarter earnings of $0.24 a share beat Mesirow's $0.23 a share estimate, the firm said.
